verdict.rationale: LangSmith has a documented native LangChain integration (gh-3) and an OpenAI SDK wrapper (`wrap_openai`, gh-1). Its integration catalog lists OpenAI, Anthropic, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI and more as ready-made ways to add tracing (docs-33, docs-40, docs-42), and community users confirm turnkey LangChain tracing (comm-2, comm-4). Missing for 10: detailed docs or hands-on evidence for the Vercel AI SDK integration beyond a catalog mention, and independent corroboration outside LangChain (one user reports weak CrewAI support).
